div.h1: Feeling at home, safe and cozy!
div.p: Book your stay in our apartment complex

Discover the best of Curaçao from Girasol Apartments, your ideal place to stay for an unforgettable stay on the island. Our complex offers comfortable one- and two-room apartments and cozy studios, perfect for various needs. Whether you are here for work, study, internship or to explore the island, our complex is hospitable and encourages social contact and togetherness. Enjoy comfortable accommodations with a homely atmosphere, conveniently located near universities, businesses and beautiful beaches. Girasol Apartments is not just a place to stay, but a home away from home where friendships are formed and unforgettable memories are made. Book your stay today and experience an unforgettable time on Curaçao at Girasol Apartments!

At Girasol Apartments you can rent studios on the top floor, two of which have a balcony. These studios offer a complete living space with an integrated kitchen, living room and sleeping area. The rental price includes water and various facilities are available. The separate bathroom guarantees privacy and provides a practical layout. Ideal for those looking for affordable, high-quality living space with all amenities within easy reach.

At Girasol Apartments, one-bedroom apartments are available on the upper and lower floors. These well-appointed apartments offer a range of amenities and are perfect for people looking for affordable and high-quality self-contained living space, slightly larger than the studios.

At Girasol Apartments, two-bedroom apartments are available, spread over the upper and lower floors. These well-appointed apartments offer a range of amenities and are perfect for those looking for an affordable and quality living space to share with a friend.

blockquote.div: During my five-month internship in Curaçao, I stayed at Girasol Apartments, and I can say with certainty that my stay there was absolutely unforgettable. The studio I stayed in offered just the right mix of comfort and privacy that I needed in addition to my work. The community atmosphere was great and the location was perfect. Girasol Apartments completely exceeded my expectations, and I highly recommend it for anyone who wants to have a great experience on the island.

div.p: Girasol Apartments, active in Curaçao since 2018, offers comfortable stays and a vibrant community for young adults. Located close to universities, companies and beautiful beaches, we are the ideal place for an internship, work period or study on the island. It is the place where our memories meet those of our guests. Welcome to Girasol Apartments, where Curaçao becomes your home and memories are made for a lifetime.

Monday to Thursday: 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM
Friday: 8:30 AM - 4:00 PM
Saturday & Sunday: Closed

Please note the time difference with the Netherlands:
April - October: -5 hours
November - March: -6 hours
